summary: Frontend-only mobile testing completed for mm/in unit updates across canvas, FreeCAD property sheet, and 3D viewer. Core inch workflow and manual/panel regression flow passed.

issues: Some icon-only touch targets appear visually near the 44px minimum and should be rechecked on real devices for reliable tap ergonomics.

action_items: Optional UX polish: verify all interactive tap targets meet >=44x44pt on physical phones.
Optional maintainability refactor: split frontend/app/canvas.tsx into smaller modules/components (>700 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/canvas.tsx is oversized (~1300 lines), increasing regression risk and making unit workflows harder to maintain/test.
3D viewer logs show an initial render pass with 0 elements before parsed route data is applied; behavior recovered in tests but is worth monitoring for startup flicker/perf.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Guest-mode UI flow and in-session canvas elements were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on mobile viewport (375x667): canvas unit toggle mm->in, property sheet inch labels/inputs, feature edit (12in x 6in x 1in) to 3D routing, viewer in/mm toggle depth conversion (1 <-> 25.4), and manual line->convert panels->3D workflow.
rca_of_issue: No blocking defects reproduced in requested scope. Observed WebGL GPU stall warnings tied to readPixels during browser preview/screenshots, not functional breakage.
